entries.1af4d5408a5831c4: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it works on 3 priority issues. First is "acceleration of global growth and optimization of product portfolio," in which it sets out concentration of resources on growth markets and strengthening of investment in high-value-added fields such as automotive parts, where environmental response and energy-saving performance are required, and the IT field and medical field, where sophistication is advancing. Second is "efficiency of productivity and supply chain," and third is "product development contributing to solving social issues," such as development of next-generation machine tools responding to automation and labor saving. Its basic management policy is to anticipate market needs based on precision technology cultivated since its founding and contribute to society through creation of new value.
